scope: Changed main text only; source comparison and claim redteam, no scientific recomputation or canonical edit.

required_corrections.issue: Universal 150 observed test histories now incorrectly includes WaterDrop. Its retained appendix states 297 test histories per endpoint (128 validation).
required_corrections.replacement: To isolate placement, we evaluate policies on the same observed test histories within each material: 150 per Goop/Sand model and 297 per WaterDrop endpoint.

required_corrections.issue: After newly defining action benefit, Its correlation grammatically attributes .214/.001 to benefit, including its own self-correlation. Both coefficients refer to the residual score.
required_corrections.replacement: The residual score correlates with base error at $.214\pm.088$ and with the benefit of its selected sparse action at $.001\pm.048$.

required_corrections.issue: E0 is now a directed native edge set while S is unordered optional pairs; E0 union S mixes incompatible types.
required_corrections.replacement: Define D(S)={(i,j),(j,i):{i,j} in S}, then use E0(x_t) union D(S), or explicitly define E0 plus S as bidirectional appending.

required_corrections.issue: Observed-table headline Training helps expanded graphs is too broad for its own WaterDrop positive mixed-minus-base Random25 effect (+0.28 +/-0.92).
required_corrections.replacement: Training and placement effects differ across materials.

required_corrections.issue: Exact edge-cardinality identity requires an exact selected-set cardinality; arbitrary S subset C alone does not imply it.
required_corrections.replacement: For an integer budget B_t>=0, select S_t subset C_R(x_t) with |S_t|=min(B_t,|C_R(x_t)|), then append both orientations.

optional_precision: Define E_A in the cost identity as the native graph with the chosen directed additions; call the first term extra directed-message count (rather than unspecified cost). No runtime equality follows.
In conclusion replace the orphan phrase what that need means with which added interactions improve prediction.
The capped native graph can grow as particles cluster, up to its receiver cap; can grow is more precise than grows.
summary: Substantive narrative improved and all main-table numeric/failure semantics are preserved. Fix history denominator, correlation antecedent, directed-pair lift, observed-table headline, and exact-budget premise before final approval.
